title: Skills storage migrated: commands/ → skills/, WAI-Skills.jsonl moved inside folder
event: Skill storage structure redesigned — commands/ renamed to skills/, index file moved inside
what_changed: Before: WAI-Spoke/commands/ (skill files), WAI-Spoke/WAI-Skills.jsonl (index at root). After: WAI-Spoke/skills/ (skill files + index co-located). templates/commands/ is UNCHANGED (framework authoring source). hub/WAI-Hub/skills/WAI-Skills.jsonl created for hub-coordination skills (separate from hub spoke skills). hub/WAI-Spoke/skills/ created for hub spoke-role skills. templates/spoke/commands/ merged into templates/spoke/skills/.
why: Skills should mirror the lugs pattern: folder named after what is inside, index lives inside the folder. Hub-role skills (wakeup/closeout) and hub-coordination skills (registry verification, health monitor) are now cleanly separated. Eliminates WAI-Spoke/commands/ name confusion — these are skills, not commands.
